summary: Learn HDFS, YARN, Hive, MapReduce, Spark, and Kafka workflow planning. Review practical Hadoop operations and analytics exercises. Explore the outline.
lede: Hadoop big data training helps data analysts, cluster operators and technical leads plan and troubleshoot distributed analytics workflows across storage, resources and processing. They practise estimating HDFS capacity, interpreting YARN queues, and reviewing Hive tables and query plans to assess how storage, resource allocation and data organization shape workload operations.
audienceIntro: Hadoop ecosystem training suits professionals who work with distributed data storage, batch processing, cluster operations, or analytics delivery. It is designed for people who need to understand how Hadoop components affect the reliability and performance of their data workflows.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with data files, tables, and analytical workflows will help you follow the examples. Coding is not required for completion; exercises focus on interpreting workflows, calculations, and design artefacts rather than writing production code.
